verses.en: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.pt: Relembra-os para se sujeitarem aos governantes e às autoridades, sejam obedientes, e estejam preparados para toda boa obra.
verses.en_web: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
verses.en_bbe: Make clear to them that they are to put themselves under rulers and authorities, to do what they are ordered, to be ready for every good work,

verses.en: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.pt: Não insultem a ninguém, não sejam briguentos, mas sim pacientes, mostrando toda mansidão para com todos os homens.
verses.en_web: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
verses.en_bbe: To say no evil of any man, not to be fighters, to give way to others, to be gentle in behaviour to all men.

verses.en: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.pt: Porque nós também éramos tolos, desobedientes, enganados, servindo a vários maus desejos e prazeres, vivendo em malícia e inveja, detestáveis, odiando uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.en_bbe: For in the past we were foolish, hard in heart, turned from the true way, servants of evil desires and pleasures, living in bad feeling and envy, hated and hating one another.

verses.en: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.pt: Mas quando a bondade e amor de Deus nosso Salvador para a humanidade apareceu,
verses.en_web: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
verses.en_bbe: But when the mercy of God our Saviour, and his love to man was seen,

verses.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
verses.pt: Não pelas obras de justiça que nós tivéssemos feito, mas sim segundo sua misericórdia, ele nos salvou pelo banho do novo nascimento, e da renovação do Espírito Santo;
verses.en_web: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
verses.en_bbe: Not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but in the measure of his mercy, he gave us salvation, through the washing of the new birth and the giving of new life in the Holy Spirit,

verses.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
verses.pt: Ao qual ele derramou abundantemente em nós por meio de Jesus Cristo nosso Salvador;
verses.en_web: whom he poured out on us richly, through Jesus Christ our Savior;
verses.en_bbe: Which he gave us freely through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

verses.en: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.pt: Para que, ao termos sido justificados por sua graça, sejamos feitos herdeiros segundo a esperança da vida eterna.
verses.en_web: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: So that, having been given righteousness through grace, we might have a part in the heritage, the hope of eternal life.

verses.en: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.pt: Esta palavra é fiel, e isto quero que insistas em confirmar, para que os que creem em Deus procurem se dedicar às boas obras; estas coisas são boas e proveitosas aos homens.
verses.en_web: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you affirm confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
verses.en_bbe: This is a true saying; and it is my desire that you may give certain witness about these things, so that those who have had faith in God may give attention to good works. These things are good and of profit to men;

verses.en: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.pt: Mas evita as questões tolas, e às genealogias e discussões, e às disputas quanto à Lei, porque elas são inúteis e vás.
verses.en_web: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.en_bbe: But have nothing to do with foolish questionings, and lists of generations, and fights and arguments about the law; for they are of no profit and foolish.

verses.en: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.pt: Ao homem rebelde, depois da primeira e da segunda repreensão, rejeita -o.
verses.en_web: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
verses.en_bbe: A man whose opinions are not those of the church, after a first and second protest, is to be kept out of your society;

verses.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.pt: Sabendo que o tal está pervertido, e está pecando, estando a si mesmo condenado.
verses.en_web: knowing that such a one is perverted and sins, being self-condemned.
verses.en_bbe: Clearly he is in error and a sinner, being self-judged.

verses.en: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.pt: Quando eu enviar Artemas até ti, ou Tíquico, procura vir até mim a Nicópolis, porque eu decidi passar lá o inverno.
verses.en_web: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
verses.en_bbe: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis: for it is my purpose to be there for the winter.

verses.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.pt: Auxilia com empenho a Zenas, o especialista na Lei, e a Apolo, na viagem deles, para que nada lhes falte.
verses.en_web: Send Zenas, the lawyer, and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
verses.en_bbe: Send Zenas, the man of law, and Apollos on their journey with all care, so that they may be in need of nothing.

verses.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.pt: E que também os nossos aprendam a se dedicarem às boas obras para os usos necessários, para que não sejam infrutíferos.
verses.en_web: Let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.
verses.en_bbe: And let our people go on with good works for necessary purposes, so that they may not be without fruit.

verses.en: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.pt: Todos os que estão comigo te saúdam. Saúda tu aos que nos amam na fé. A graça seja com todos vós. Amém! A carta a Tito, o primeiro bispo escolhido da igreja dos cretenses, foi escrita de Nicópolis na Macedônia
verses.en_web: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: All who are with me send you their love. Give our love to our friends in the faith. Grace be with you all.
